shapeSummary: Flat 0.254 mm thick force-sensing resistor laminate, with thickness along Y and the bottom at Y=0. A 7.62 mm diameter round pad at one end joins a 6 mm wide rectangular tail. Two flat 0.8 mm wide pins at 2.54 mm spacing extend from the tail end. Overall length is about 20 mm along Z, centered at Z=0. No holes.
warnings: Overall length of about 20 mm is estimated from the photo and is unverified.
Tail width (6 mm), pin width (0.8 mm) and pin length are estimated.
Pins are modeled as flat strips with the same thickness as the laminate.
The pad narrows into the tail in the photo; this is simplified to a circle plus a rectangle.
Thickness is placed along Y to satisfy the bottom-at-Y=0 rule, which differs from the Z thickness axis in the image analysis.
The printed traces, active-area graphics, logos and the solder-clip detail on the pins are omitted.
